name: talebuilder
description: Make personalized children's picture books from your AI assistant. Describe an idea and TaleBuilder writes the story, draws the characters and the cover as a free preview, then illustrates every page.

interface.shortDescription: Picture books for the children in your life
interface.longDescription: For parents and teachers. Describe a story idea, pick a grade from kindergarten to grade 5, and TaleBuilder writes a ten-page picture book, draws its characters and cover as a free preview, and can illustrate every page using acorns on your TaleBuilder account.
defaultPrompt: Use TaleBuilder to make a bedtime story about a shy owl who wants to sing, for a first grader.
Use TaleBuilder to check on my latest book.
